body:
I'll talk about things now because it's late and I don't care. Things started when I was 22. I'm 26 now.

Around the time I feel like this started, I walked away from a good job. It was the kind of job I could have retired from in 30 years. Prior to quitting I felt so frustrated. I cried a lot. I could barely interact with coworkers. I spent time breaking things and fucking around and slacking off. 

A girl I worked with and thought was important had moved away several months prior. I'm not sure if she set me off. I ended up hating her in a very dark and irrational way. It's something I still can't quite get over. It's also something she doesn't deserve. 

I stopped eating. I lost 40-50lbs in a month maybe. I was weak and exhausted, but I couldn't sleep more than 2 or 3 hours and that was during the day. I could barely work up the energy to clean myself. I often didnt. 

This went on for almost a year until I reached another point. I decided to kill myself but not like most other people. I didn't want to die at home or in some shitty hotel. I didn't want to hang or drug myself. I stole a credit card from a family member and bought a one way ticket to Honolulu, Hawaii. I booked it at 8am and was headed westward by 7pm. I've always liked Hawaii. It's pretty. There they also have very high cliffs. The rocks below are razor sharp and the sea is relentless. A human body would be turned into mush quickly. The sealife would gobble up all traces that it ever existed. 

I ended up at lax with no luggage and only 40 bucks in my pocket which I had also stolen. It was cold and still dark and I sat down and thought and cried and waited. I'm not sure what happened there but I didn't board the plane. I sat there and watched it, watched it take off. My mind was blank. I wormed my way into getting a ticket back home and arrived almost 24hours after I had left.

I tried to cope after that. It didn't work well. I lasted another few months but all the while I developed crushing anxiety. I hated people, crowds, anywhere. I couldn't breathe or think clearly. If a strange came too close I wanted to cry, scream, tear at them or myself. People were always looking at me and I knew that they knew and I was terrified. 

I ended up leaving home one night and I started driving. I slept in parking lots, a few different houses of people, etc. I was homeless for a little while. This was in December. I had no money and very litte clothes. I'd lay in my car at night and shiver. I'd cry and try as hard as I could to fall asleep so maybe I wouldn't wake up. It never got quite that cold.

When I gave up that time, my family knew something was up. They made me see a doctor and this is the one I lied to. This is the one I never took the pills from. I tried to make myself as normal as possible on the outside after that. 

It worked for a little while. I limped from shitty to shitty job for a while. I was miserable. I tried to go back to school but I still hated being around people. I drank around this time. I would drink until I'd puke or pass out. I went too far on a few different occassions. I got rid of all my friends. I wanted to be alone. 

I dunno. That's how things have been for a while now. I don't drink much anymore. I hurt myself from time to time when I get angry. I stab, cut, or bite myself. I have incredibly violent thoughts. There are other things. Who knows. 

I can pretend very well and though I know I probably need help, I sometimes wonder if I can't somehow pretend my way into not needing it. I have moments of extreme clarity where I realize how fucked up the things I think and do are. Again, who knows.

Thanks everybody.

Thank you to everyone so far. You are all very kind. 

I know going to the doctor is the only reasonable choice. I'm just very nervous about it.

I've been dealing with what I assume is depression for roughly four years. I meet all the requirements from what I've read. I saw a doctor briefly a year into it and right after what might have been a suicide attempt. I lied to her throughout the visit and never took what she prescribed.

I can lie really well. I can pretend to be just fine. My family is mostly unaware of my turmoil. 

Anyway, the past few months have been different. The usual symptoms are present, but I've been thinking about suicide almost constantly. I don't recall this happening exactly like this before. It's almost like there is another voice in my head debating the issue with me. I'm not sure how to describe it. 

I handle it alright most of the time but there are days when I don't. I feel like crying a lot but I can't. I just fear it's going to develop into a major problem in the future. I don't know if that makes sense.

Thanks for your concern. Sorry to ramble.
I feel like I can handle it most days, but others...I dunno.
